description:
Ethereum mainnet on-chain read: the native balance of an address. Ethereum mainnet ETH balance for one address via eth_getBalance. Takes address (0x + 40 hex) and returns the hex balance in wei.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/eth_mainnet_eth_getbalance. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
Measured output: {"chain": "ethereum", "hex": "0x50122e9e75120cc5", "method": "eth_getBalance", "ok": true, "result": 5769725330718854341, "service": "x402_eth_reads_v1.eth_mainnet_eth_getbalance"}
name: x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_eth_getbalance
